It explains what happens at the desk for regular visitors

Companion Animal Travel Desk Arrival Guide

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers check pets in without drama. The process is meant to be calm, orderly, and safe for the animal. Bring your pet's travel papers, crate, and any required care notes so the desk staff can review them before you move on.

If you are traveling with a rabbit, the health paperwork is checked first so nothing gets missed. <<FACT F082>> Keep the papers together and easy to reach, because loose sheets slow the line and create avoidable stress. The desk will look for signs that the animal is fit to travel and that the documents match the booking.

Cats need sturdy carriers that give enough room to stand, turn, and lie down comfortably. <<FACT F067>> A carrier that is too small or flimsy is a safety problem, not a minor detail. Bring bedding that stays in place and avoid anything that can snag or tip over during handling.

At the desk, staff will compare the pet details with the travel record, check the crate door, and look for secure closures. They may also ask whether the animal has eaten recently, needs medication, or requires a quieter wait. Keep your pet under control and do not open the crate unless staff tells you to do so. That keeps the area safer for everyone nearby.

Travelers with more than one animal should present each pet separately, even if the trip is under one booking. Pack each crate with clear labels and make sure the contents are simple and tidy. Good preparation cuts down delays and helps the team move pets through the process with less noise and confusion.

Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is there to keep the handoff clear. If you need more help, speak with the desk staff at the airport or contact customer support before you travel.
